title: SQL FCI backup: COPY_ONLY to the shared LUN
description: The nexus-cli backup take verb for the SQL Server FCI: a COPY_ONLY full backup of nexus_demo to S:\\Backups (does not disturb the AG log chain). The matching restore (round-trip verify) is the handbook playbook.

observe.what: the backupId (.bak), destination on S:\\Backups, size, and duration; pass the backupId to `nexus backup restore sqlserver <id> --yes` for the RESTORE-WITH-MOVE round-trip (8225 rows)

whatProves: the FCI can take a consistent COPY_ONLY backup of the AG database to the shared LUN; restore verifies it round-trips into a throwaway verify DB.
